last_sync.summary: Capoworks ECU clarified the lambda-protection minimum and restore load thresholds so their guidance follows the selected lambda load source instead of always showing percent. The two merge commits integrate that change and add no further user-facing behavior.

decisions.rationale: The lambda-protection minimum and restore load fields no longer display a fixed percent unit. Their help text now states that thresholds use the selected lambda load source units: MAP or effective MAP in kPa, throttle, pedal or cylinder filling in percent, and fuel-model units for Model default. No tune layout or value range changed, so no retune or migration is required; existing numeric thresholds keep their stored values but must be read in the units of the currently selected Threshold load source.
evidence: firmware/integration/fome_config.txt: lambdaProtectionMinLoad units changed from "%" to "" with new help text about selected lambda load source units
firmware/integration/fome_config.txt: lambdaProtectionRestoreLoad units changed from "%" to "" with the same help text
firmware/CHANGELOG.md: added Fixed entry about misleading lambda-protection min/restore load units
